## AI Research Findings (Dream Cycle 2026-04-04)

### Attention Factors for Statistical Arbitrage (arXiv:2510.11616, Oct 2025)
- Jointly learns conditional latent factors and trading policy to maximize post-cost risk-adjusted returns
- Gross Sharpe > 4.0, Net Sharpe 2.3 on US large-cap equities over 24 years (1999-2023)
- Key insight: classical pairs trading fails because pairs share common market/sector factor exposure; trading factor-purged residuals eliminates spurious spread divergences
- Practical application: Before cointegration testing in R29, run OLS regression of each asset's returns on (SPY, sector ETF) and use the residuals. ~10 lines of Python, major impact on signal quality.
- Published: ACM ICAIF 2025 (6th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance)

### Put-Writing with VIX-Kelly Hybrid Sizing (arXiv:2508.16598, Aug 2025)
- Systematic put-writing on S&P 500 index options (SPXW/SPY puts)
- Key finding: far OTM (delta 0.10-0.15), ultra-short-dated (0-5 DTE) puts deliver superior risk-adjusted returns
- Three sizing methods tested: fixed, VIX-scaled, Kelly-VIX hybrid
- Hybrid method wins: Kelly fraction (from historical VRP ratio) scaled by (20/VIX) — best Sharpe AND lowest drawdown
- George application → Round 32: systematic SPX/SPY put-writing with VIX-Kelly hybrid sizing
- Complements R25 covered calls (individual stocks) — index put-writing is a separate, orthogonal alpha source

### SAE-FiRE: Earnings Surprise Prediction via Sparse Autoencoder (arXiv:2505.14420, May 2025)
- Sparse Autoencoder decomposition of LLM hidden states + ANOVA/tree-based feature selection
- Addresses noise problem in long financial documents (>5,000 words, substantial redundancy)
- Outperforms baseline approaches at predicting earnings surprise direction across 3 financial datasets
- George application → R31 amendment: if basic FinBERT score averaging underperforms, use hidden-state extraction + SelectKBest (top 50 of 768 dimensions) as fallback signal construction method
- Note: adds complexity, requires labeled training set — use only if Approach A (averaged FinBERT) disappoints

### DeePM: Regime-Robust Deep Learning for Macro Portfolio Management (arXiv:2601.05975, Jan 2026)
- Deep learning portfolio manager trained end-to-end on 50 diversified futures (2010-2025)
- 2x net risk-adjusted return vs classical trend-following; 50% improvement over Momentum Transformer SOTA
- Three innovations: causal sieve for async data (ragged filtration), Macroeconomic Graph Prior for cross-asset regularization, distributionally robust EVaR objective
- Robust across 2010s 'CTA Winter', 2020 COVID crash, 2022 rate shock regimes
- George application: NOT directly actionable for equity-focused backtest (futures universe, complex DL architecture). File as reference for future macro futures work.

- Round 31: Text-based PEAD — QUEUED (SAE feature selection as optional enhancement if FinBERT averaging disappoints)
- Round 32 (NEW): Systematic SPX put-writing with VIX-Kelly hybrid sizing — QUEUED (can run independently, no data subscriptions needed beyond yfinance + FRED)
